newsitem.title: USA: Voice Powered Tech sees Q3 hurt by delays.
newsitem.headline: Voice Powered Tech sees Q3 hurt by delays.

text.p: Voice Powered Technology International Inc said Friday it expects third quarter results to be reduced by order delays, operational problems and previous losses in the first half of 1996.
The forward-looking statements were contained in a press release, which separately announced the company's intention to find a strategic relationship with another company that may include a merger.
"We believe that developing a strategic alliance is in our company's best interests," said President Edward Krakauer in a statement accompanying the announcement.

"Our decision to raise additional financing stems in part from losses sustained during the first two quarters of 1996, production start-up problems which delayed shipments of...products until late September 1996 and which will negatively impact our third quarter sales, profits and working capital position," Krakauer said.
The company said the delays in shipment of its Professional Voice Organizer and Voice Organizer/Pager resulted in a fourth-quarter order backlog of $2.5 million, most of which was filled in October.
